project: The Legend of Peach: A Mario to the Mushroom Kingdom
scoring_policy: Independent 26-dimension rubric (14 historical v0.10.0 dimensions preserved for longitudinal comparison + 12 new v0.20.0 AAA engineering dimensions). Every dimension has an explicit formula, validation tier, and honest remaining gap. Physical SNES hardware is NEVER assumed passed without real console execution.
why_v0200_not_v100: Physical SNES / Super Famicom / FXPAK Pro console execution is 0/1 (HARDWARE_NOT_TESTED locally).

A continuous uninterrupted 100% blank-SRAM start-to-credits playthrough across all 11 dungeons without room-warp harnesses has not yet been completed (opening blank-SRAM chapter + Rainy Overworld + Save + Cold Reboot is PLAYTHROUGH_PASS; all 12 bosses, 4 playable heroes, 4-hop bidirectional warp chain & 3-slot SRAM v2 are VISUAL_PASS).
Additional reference emulators (Ares, standalone bsnes GUI, Snes9x, Mesen 2) are NOT_INSTALLED on this build host.
